name: orbital
description: Your agent takes the Tana work you hand it in Orbital: Orbital's agent relay and Tana's MCP server in one plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Hand Tana work to your agent
interface.longDescription: Assign a Tana task or note to your agent in Orbital, on the Mac or the phone, and it does the work in Tana. The plugin brings both servers the agent needs: Orbital's relay, which tells it what you handed it, and Tana's MCP server, where it reads and writes the node with your own Tana access. Setup links it to your Orbital with a one-time code.
defaultPrompt: What has Orbital handed you lately?
